messages:
eli: Quick heads-up — shipping window closes in ~3h (18:00 PT). If you need a hotpatch, request an exception now with owner + risk. No surprises after noon please.
shani: Pushing the changelog update now. @ryan can you give a quick docs-bump ack?
ryan: On it, skimming PR #8421 — looks fine, one test flake I want fixed but no blocker.
tia: @eli I need a late merge for a telemetry NPE fix (tiny null-check). PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/repo/pull/8429 — low risk, hitting prod. Can we get an exception?
eli: Copy. Can you include the minimal repro and rollback plan in the PR description? Also paste the failing trace if available.
tia: Added stacktrace and rollback: revert commit 8a7f9d if anything goes sideways. Repro steps in PR body.
release-bot: Reminder: deploy window lock scheduled at 1768510800 (enforces branch protection). Use `/release-exception` to file requests.
max: If we grant, please do a canary deploy first and monitor error budget closely. Also include the exact deploy command in the PR notes.
tia: Filing exception now: `/release-exception --reason "telemetry NPE in prod 17:23" --pr 8429 --risk low --owner @tia`
eli: Thanks. @ryan please review and comment LGTM or block so I can escalate to release manager.
ryan: LGTM. Left one tiny nit in PR comment (non-blocking). :thumbsup:
eli: OK, exception approved from my side. @release-bot escalate to release-manager and queue canary. CI must pass before merge.
release-bot: Exception ticket created: RM-2026-17. Escalated to @lia. CI status: pending.
lia: I'll triage in ~10m. Oncall, can you watch canary traffic once deployed? @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: Standing by. Will monitor error budget + p99 latency. I’ll add a temporary alert for telemetry error spikes.
tia: Squashing & pushing now. Commands:```bash
git checkout -b fix/telemetry-npe
git cherry-pick 8a7f9d
git push origin fix/telemetry-npe
gh pr create --fill
```
release-bot: CI passed for PR 8429. Canary deploy queued (canary-77).
ops-oncall: Canary running — first 15m looks green. Errors = 0, p95 latency unchanged.
lia: Exception approved. Please merge to main and bump buildstamp + changelog.
tia: Merged to main. Changelog entry: "fix(telemetry): avoid NPE when user has no session (fixes #8429)". Buildstamp bumped to 2026.01.14-1123.
eli: Thanks everyone. Reminder — final soft-freeze still at 18:00 PT. Any other hotpatch asks, call them out now.
shani: Adding final release notes to #docs-release and prepping the release artifact. :shipit:
max: ETA for cutover artifact publish?
shani: publishing at 17:50 PT, will tag release v1.12.3 shortly after freeze.
eli: Perfect. Closing this thread once artifact is live. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
